notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.3 - 06-22-2020
notes.content:
Hello!
Today we have for you a patch that improves the performance of few objects and fixes possible glitches of wall tilesets on higher zooms.

Changes made in patch 1.0.3:
[list]
[*]changes to wall tilesets,
[*]impromevent to fan performance,
[*]improvement to flamethrowers performance,
[*]bug fix that caused doors to get stuck sometimes,
[*]added functionality to allow players to switch between all, local and Steam Workshop levels in the Custom level selection screen.
[/list]

Have fun!

notes.title: Steam Workshop available!
notes.content:
Hello,
today we have great news for you - Steam Workshop is now available in Box Kid Adventures. Now with ease, you can share levels created in Constructor - built-in level editor for Box Kid Adventures.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2000895710

Today's update also brings some changes and fixes:[list]
[*]increased the speed of rewinding,
[*]fixed bug that caused loading of a quicksave instead of restarting a level, after beating a level,
[*]fixed bug that caused the game window to minimize after pressing the Escape key,
[*]improved the level load system in the Constructor,
[*]change the system of recording player results in user-created levels (unfortunately, this means loss of all results achieved before the patch - we apologize for the inconvenience)
[*]increased the limit of undoing in the Constructor.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.0.1 - 02.02.2020
notes.content:
Hello!
Today we have for you a small update:[list]
[*]fixed a bug that could crash the game after rewinding,
[*]added descriptions to the animated keys/buttons of the tutorial in the first levels,
[*]speed up the showing of descriptions of buttons on the screen after player's death.
[/list]
